# IEW: India Electronics Week 2026

## INDIA’S ONLY CONFERENCE & EXPO PROMOTING

## R&D IN ELECTRONICS

## **5-7 May 2027**

## **VENUE:** KTPO Convention Centre, Whitefield, Bengaluru, India  

## India Electronics Week (IEW) is India's only electronics event for the Creators of electronics products. It focuses on R&D and New Product Development of electronics. Be it the chip, the PCB, the circuit or the complete embedded systems' solution--IEW has conference tracks to cater to R&D and NPD teams of all.

## Enabling R&D and Innovation

### Discover latest technologies, components, techniques & best-practices for innovating in the field of electronics

### Engage with suppliers & service providers who can truly help you develop your idea into an innovative product, quickly

## THE HIGHLIGHTS: TECH CONFERENCES & WORKSHOPS

[![](https://www.indiaelectronicsweek.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/erocks.png)](https://electronicsrocks.com/)

## Tech conference focused on designing, prototyping, and testing next-generation electronic circuits and hardware products

[![](https://www.indiaelectronicsweek.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/embeddedindia.png)](https://embedded-india.com/)

## Tech conference for engineers building intelligent, connected, and high-performance embedded systems

[![](https://www.indiaelectronicsweek.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/iotshow.png)](https://www.iotshow.in/)

## Tech conference for developers and innovators creating scalable AI and IoT-driven solutions for real-world applications.

[![](https://www.indiaelectronicsweek.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/hands-on-workshop.png)](https://www.iotshow.in/)

## Hands-on workshops building advanced electronics, AI, and IoT solutions for real-world applications.

## THE HIGHLIGHTS: R&D AWARDS

![](https://www.indiaelectronicsweek.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/RD-Awards-logos.png)

## An annual initiative to recognise excellence in innovation by India's best R&D and New Product Development teams.

## THE HIGHLIGHTS: VENTURE & SME GROWTH TRACK

## Conference

## Insight-driven sessions for founders and SMEs to scale ventures, secure funding, and drive business growth.

## Masterclasses

## Expert-led masterclasses for founders and SMEs to build strategies, secure funding, and accelerate business growth.

## B2B Dating: Investors with SMEs & Startups

## Curated networking for founders and SMEs to connect with investors, secure funding, and drive business growth.

## THE HIGHLIGHTS: CO-LOCATED EVENT

[![](https://www.indiaelectronicsweek.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/bharat-ai_logo-1024x507.png)](https://bharatai.info/)

Conference for accelerating real-world deployment of AI solutions across Bharat

## WHAT'S SPECIAL?

## Hands-on workshops and Indepth Technical Tutorial sessions to train techies on cutting edge tech, and best practices.

## With 2,000 plus delegates attending annually— amongst Asia's largest conferences on electronics.

## Blessed with support of India's top electronics Gurus who speak at IEW conferences.

## Annually held at the Silicon Valley of India: Bengaluru (aka Bangalore).
